title: Planning with Files: Claude Code skill that brings workflow behind Manus straight into your terminal
description:
Want to work like the AI startup Meta just bought for $2 billion? Meet Planning with Files — a Claude Code skill that brings the workflow behind Manus straight into your terminal. Here’s the secret: Markdown as working memory. Instead of cramming everything into the AI’s fragile context, you save notes, progress, and checkpoints on disk. Each file becomes a scratch pad, letting Claude remember what matters across tasks.
https://github.com/OthmanAdi/planning-with-files
